items.title: Pay the claimed amount (if the debt is accepted)
items.quote: begleichen Sie die Summe samt laufender Zinsen binnen zwei Wochen seit Zustellung dieses Bescheids direkt bei der Antragstellerin.
items.computation: The Zustellungsvermerk states personal delivery on Friday 2026-11-20 ('übergeben am 20.11.2026 an den Empfänger persönlich'). This is actual formal service by the court (§ 180 ZPO), so no statutory deemed-delivery fiction applies; the anchor is the stated receipt date itself. Under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event (20.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 21.11.2026. Under § 188(2) BGB a two-week period ends on the day of the second week bearing the same name as the day of the triggering event, i.e. a Friday: 2026-11-20 + 2 weeks = 2026-12-04 (Friday). 2026-12-04 is not a Saturday, Sunday or Bavarian public holiday, so no shift under § 222 ZPO applies. Final day: 2026-12-04.

items.title: File Widerspruch with the Mahngericht (if the claim is disputed)
items.quote: Bestreiten Sie sie ganz oder zum Teil, teilen Sie dem Mahngericht innerhalb derselben Frist mit, dass Sie Widerspruch erheben; verwenden Sie dafür möglichst den beigelegten Vordruck.
items.computation: The letter sets the same two-week period ('innerhalb derselben Frist') for lodging Widerspruch as for payment, running from the personal delivery on Friday 2026-11-20. Applying § 187(1) BGB (day of delivery excluded, counting starts 2026-11-21) and § 188(2) BGB (period of weeks ends on the matching weekday two weeks later), the period ends Friday 2026-12-04. Not a weekend/holiday in Bayern, so § 222 ZPO causes no shift. The Widerspruch must reach the Mahngericht by this date.

warnings: This is a Mahnbescheid: the court has not examined the claim ('Das Gericht hat ihren Anspruch nicht geprüft') — it is based solely on the claimant's own statements, so the debt is not yet legally confirmed.
The payment demand includes 'laufende Zinsen' (ongoing interest) in addition to the stated 364,70 EUR total, so the exact amount owed by the deadline may be slightly higher than the printed total.

If neither payment nor Widerspruch is filed in time, the claimant can obtain a Vollstreckungsbescheid (enforcement order) allowing account seizure — verify the underlying gym membership debt before paying or ignoring this.

Double-check the claimant's identity and address (Exempel Fitnesswelt GmbH & Co. KG, represented by Rechtsanwältin Dr. Muster) and that you actually had or still have this gym membership before acting.
